title: Honoring Father and Mother
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Honoring father and mother means giving proper respect, care, gratitude, and responsibility toward parents according to God’s command. This honor is real, but it is always governed by obedience to God and wisdom in situations of sin or harm.
summary: Honoring father and mother means giving proper respect, care, gratitude, and responsibility toward parents according to God’s command. This honor is real, but it is always governed by obedience to God and wisdom in situations of sin or harm.
christFocus: Jesus Christ fulfilled righteousness perfectly and corrected religious excuses that neglected care for parents. He also teaches that loyalty to God must be supreme over every earthly relationship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God commands honor toward father and mother. This command is not a minor family preference, but part of God’s moral instruction for His people.

Honor includes respect, gratitude, listening, care, and responsibility where appropriate. Scripture rebukes religious hypocrisy that uses spiritual language to avoid caring for parents.

Yet honoring parents does not mean obeying sin or enabling abuse. Obedience to God remains highest. Wisdom may require boundaries, protection, counsel, or distance in situations of harm.

Christ teaches believers to hold both truth and love together. Family honor must be real, but it must never be used to excuse evil or silence the vulnerable.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people use this command to control or shame others, while others dismiss it completely because family relationships are painful. Scripture gives a wiser path: honor rightly, under God, with truth and discernment.

This doctrine helps believers care for aging parents, repent of contempt, and also seek safety and wisdom where family sin has caused harm.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor your parents in ways that are faithful to God and wise before Him. Repent of bitterness, neglect, or contempt where needed, but do not confuse honor with obeying sin or enabling harm. Seek counsel for complicated family wounds and ask Christ for wisdom and grace.
